current: Dressing-room photo banner with 3 metric tiles, a 7-card SquadDepth strip, 4 tab buttons and one horizontally scrolling roster table (~19 columns on Översikt). Compare and captaincy hide behind a max-2 checkbox aside; position chips are duplicated below the table.
reason: The squad list is the most-used workspace; a matrix with saved views and player chips removes the 19-column scroll, makes readiness scannable and adds the missing bulk actions. Ship the Depth Chart (C) as the SQD-01f panel on top of it rather than as the whole page.

alternatives.name: Squad Matrix
alternatives.concept: A dense, sortable roster where every row starts with a "player chip" (shirt number, name, position, energy bar, match-fitness band pip, morale dot, 5-match form sparkline). The four hard tabs become saved views (Matchberedskap, Prestation, Kontraktsrisk, Utveckling) with a column chooser; a multi-select tray carries actions.
alternatives.layout: Control panel row (view switcher, search, position segmented filter V6–MV, state filter, density toggle); full-width roster table with 8 default columns; sticky selection tray at the bottom when rows are selected.
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Availability and readiness per row (chip colours, Tillgänglighet). 2) Squad role and season output (Trupproll, Betyg, Mål, Skott%/Räddn%). 3) Contract end and wage in the Kontraktsrisk view only.
alternatives.interactions: Sort any column (incl. Skott % and Räddn %); click/shift-click or tap-select rows; tray actions: Jämför (2), Sätt trupproll (bulk), Vila (sets REST load in training), Kapten / vice / 7 m, Transferlista; row click opens Peek drawer; saved custom views; ⌘K "visa trötta spelare".
alternatives.navigation: Laget hub › Truppen. Row → Peek → "Öppna profil" (SQD-02). Tray deep-links to /career/compare, /career/training (load) and /career/contracts with the player preselected.
alternatives.desktop: Fits 1280 px without horizontal scroll at 8 columns; Detailed density reveals up to 14; sticky header and sticky first column.
alternatives.mobile: Rows collapse to ranked cards showing the chip plus the current view's top 3 metrics; views become a horizontal chip scroller; selection tray becomes a bottom sheet; long-press = Peek.
pros: Readiness visible at a glance via chips
Bulk actions save many round trips
Saved views serve both casual and spreadsheet players
cons: Column chooser and saved views add settings surface
Bulk "Vila" must respect injury/limited constraints already enforced on training

d: Control panel: views · search · position · state · density|12|nav
Selection tray: Jämför · Trupproll · Vila · Kapten|12|cta

alternatives.name: Locker Room
alternatives.concept: The dressing room as the page: a wall of lockers, one per player, grouped in seven position bays. Each locker shows shirt number, portrait, a readiness ring (energy + match fitness), a morale glow and injury/suspension tags; the captain armband hangs in its owner's locker.
alternatives.layout: Full-bleed dressing-room hero with squad mood strip (average morale, average match fitness, available n/N, captain); below, 7 bays (MV, V6, V9, M9, M6, H9, H6) of locker cards; a side panel opens for the selected player.
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Who is out or tired (lockers dim, tags). 2) Squad mood and captaincy. 3) Stats on the back of the card.
alternatives.interactions: Tap a locker to flip it (back: season stats, Trupproll, Avtal till); long-press = Peek; drag the armband to another locker or tap "Gör till kapten"; filter dims non-matching lockers instead of hiding them.
alternatives.navigation: Locker → Athlete Spotlight profile; "Matrisvy" link switches to the Squad Matrix for sorting work.
alternatives.desktop: Seven bays as columns, lockers stacked; side panel 4/12 wide.
alternatives.mobile: Swipe between bays (one position per screen) with a 2-column locker grid; flip on tap; armband via action sheet.
pros: Great for screenshots and B identity
cons: Weak for sorting and comparing 20+ players
Needs new data: player portraits (asset pipeline)
Flip cards hide data behind interaction

d: Dressing room hero + squad mood strip|12|hero

alternatives.name: Depth Chart
alternatives.concept: A court-shaped depth chart: seven position slots on a handball court, each listing its depth (primary-position players, then secondary-position cover) with a readiness heat chip. A ledger column beside it summarises squad numbers; below, a compact list grouped by position.
alternatives.layout: Left 7/12: court with 7 slots; right 5/12: "Truppen i siffror" ledger (size, average match fitness, injuries with return dates, contracts ending ≤180 d); below: position-grouped list with chips.
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Positional gaps (slot turns warning when fewer than 2 available). 2) Who covers each slot. 3) Supporting numbers in the ledger.
alternatives.interactions: Tap a slot to filter the list; overlay toggle (Energi / Matchträning / Form / Avtal) recolours chips; tap a name for Peek; "Öppna i taktiktavlan" jumps to the same slot on TRN-02.
alternatives.navigation: Slot → TRN-02 court with that position focused; list rows → SQD-02.
alternatives.desktop: Court and ledger side by side; list below spans 12.
alternatives.mobile: Court becomes a vertical position list ("H6: Lindqvist · Ek · (Berg)") with heat chips; ledger collapses into a summary card at top.
pros: Answers "do I have cover at H6 on Saturday?" instantly
Shows secondary positions that are invisible today
cons: Needs new data: an explicit depth order (or derive it from squad tier + ability)
Weaker for contract and performance tasks
Court layout cramped for big squads

current: Default roster tab showing the union of performance, physical and contract-end columns (~19 columns), the widest table in the game.
reason: A curated 8-column summary with expandable rows keeps everything reachable without horizontal scroll; the readiness view (C) becomes a saved view in SQD-01.

alternatives.name: Curated summary + expandable rows
alternatives.concept: Översikt shows 8 columns: chip, Pos, Trupproll, readiness strip, Form (5M), Betyg, Mål or Räddn %, Avtal till. Expanding a row reveals the remaining stats inline.
alternatives.layout: Single table; expanded row shows a two-line detail band (performance left, physical right).
alternatives.hierarchy: Chip and readiness first, output second, contract third.
alternatives.interactions: Click/tap row chevron to expand; keyboard ←/→ collapses/expands.
alternatives.navigation: Expanded band links to profile tabs (?tab=).
alternatives.mobile: Cards with chip + 3 metrics; expand reveals the rest as key-value pairs.

alternatives.name: Readiness cards
alternatives.concept: Overview as a card grid sorted by availability, each card a large chip with energy ring, match-fitness band and next-match status.
alternatives.interactions: Tap card = Peek; select mode for bulk actions.
cons: Poor for comparing numbers across players

alternatives.name: Next-match readiness grouping
alternatives.concept: Overview grouped into Tillgängliga / Tveksamma / Borta with return dates, followed by a contract-warning strip, framed as "Inför lördagens match".
alternatives.hierarchy: Who can play next match, then risks.
alternatives.interactions: Tap a doubtful player to see reasons (load trend, outlook) inline, not in tooltips.
alternatives.navigation: Header links to MDY-01 match preview.
alternatives.mobile: Stacked groups with sticky group headers.
pros: Directly tied to the next decision

current: Prestation tab: M, Starter, Mål, Skott % / försök, Räddningar % / mötta, Betyg and a 5-match form sparkline; shot % and save % are not sortable.
reason: Separating goalkeeper and outcourt metric sets and making every metric sortable fixes the real weakness with little cost.

alternatives.name: Position-aware stat tables
alternatives.concept: Two stacked tables: Utespelare (M, Starter, Mål, Mål/match, Skott %, Betyg, Form) and Målvakter (M, Räddn %, Räddn/match, mötta skott, Betyg, Form); all sortable, per-match values derived from appearances.
alternatives.interactions: Sort, inline bars in numeric cells.
alternatives.mobile: Cards per player with the 3 key metrics of their role.

alternatives.name: Small multiples
alternatives.concept: A grid of mini charts per player: rating line over the last matches and goal/save bars, sorted by average rating.
alternatives.interactions: Tap a multiple to open the profile performance chart.
pros: Shows form trends, not just totals
cons: Uses per-match history only available via profile match log

current: Fysisk status tab with Energi %, Matchträning %, Belastning 7 d, Trend arrows, Återhämtning (reasons only in title tooltips), Tillgänglighet and Återkomst.
reason: A readiness heat-strip with visible risk bands and reason chips makes the workload story legible and touch-accessible; the same strip is reused on training (TRN-01c).
dependencies: Readiness heat-strip component (shared with TRN-01c, MDY-01)

alternatives.name: Readiness heat-strip
alternatives.concept: Each player row is a strip of coloured cells: Energi, Matchträning band (with 80 % full-effect marker), 7 d load vs 28 d average ratio, Trend, Utsikt; reasons appear as chips ("2 matcher på 4 dagar") rather than tooltips.
alternatives.layout: Table with heat cells + legend with explicit bands (Pigg ≥80, Något sliten ≥55, Trött).
alternatives.hierarchy: Risk colour first, value second, reason third.
alternatives.interactions: Sort by risk; tap a reason chip for an explanation; row action "Vila / Reducerad" sets training load.
alternatives.navigation: Load action writes to TRN-01c; row → SQD-02h.
alternatives.mobile: Each player a compact card with a 5-segment strip and the worst reason chip.
pros: Unifies three load numbers into one story
cons: Requires agreeing one load semantics with TRN-01c and ANL-01c

alternatives.name: Load quadrant board
alternatives.concept: A scatter board: energy on x, 7-day load ratio on y, quadrants labelled Redo / Bevaka / Vila / Bygg upp; each dot is a player chip.
alternatives.interactions: Tap dot → panel with numbers and load action; lasso-select for bulk rest.
alternatives.mobile: Chart full width with bottom sheet for the selected dot.
pros: Whole squad risk in one picture

current: Kontrakt tab with Avtal till, Lön / månad and an Åtgärd link that only opens the profile root; duplicates /career/contracts with fewer features.
reason: Keeping contract risk one tap away inside the squad is useful, but the action must open the renewal itself, not the profile root.

alternatives.name: Remove and deep-link
alternatives.concept: Drop the tab; a "Kontrakt" control-panel link opens SQD-05 pre-filtered to the squad.
alternatives.layout: No tab; link in control panel.
cons: Contract context leaves the squad screen

alternatives.name: Kontraktsrisk view + renewal drawer
alternatives.concept: A saved view sorted by days left with a countdown bar per row; "Förläng" opens the renewal flow (SQD-02n) in a drawer.
alternatives.hierarchy: Days left, then wage, then status.
alternatives.interactions: Drawer renewal without leaving the squad.
cons: Two places can start a renewal

current: An aria-live aside appears above the table when 1–2 rows are ticked, mixing captaincy and compare; the compare CTA sits in the panel header.
reason: A floating tray with contextual actions separates selection from its jobs and scales to bulk actions.

alternatives.name: Floating selection tray
alternatives.concept: Bottom-docked tray listing selected chips and actions that adapt to the count (1: Kapten, Vila, Profil; 2: Jämför; n: Trupproll, Vila).
alternatives.interactions: Remove chip to deselect; Esc clears.
alternatives.mobile: Bottom sheet above the tab bar.
cons: Must not cover the Continue button

alternatives.name: Inline duel preview
alternatives.concept: With two players selected, a slim panel shows a radar overlay and 4 delta bars inline, with "Öppna full jämförelse".

current: SquadDepth strip: "SJU POSITIONER. ETT LAG." with 7 position cards showing available/total; not clickable, ignores secondary positions.
reason: The mini court makes coverage spatial and doubles as the position filter, removing the duplicated chip row.

alternatives.name: Clickable position counters
alternatives.concept: Seven segmented counters (available/total + secondary cover count) that act as the position filter.
alternatives.interactions: Tap to filter, tap again to clear.

alternatives.name: Mini court depth
alternatives.concept: Handball half-court with the 7 spots; each spot shows available/total and is coloured green/amber/red by cover, secondary cover as a small "+n".
alternatives.interactions: Tap spot filters; long-press lists the cover names.

current: "Inga spelare matchar dina filter." text under an empty table; the reset button is not repeated.
reason: A helpful empty state explains why and offers both reset and the nearest result.

alternatives.name: Reset-first empty state
alternatives.concept: Message plus the active filters as removable chips and one "Rensa filter" button.
alternatives.interactions: Remove one chip or reset all.

alternatives.name: Explaining empty state
alternatives.concept: Explains the zero ("0 tillgängliga V6 — 2 skadade, åter 14 nov") and shows the nearest matches plus reset.
pros: Turns a dead end into information

current: One dossier for any player: photo PlayerHero, a flat action row, own-player Tillstånd panel, 6 local-state tabs that recombine the same blocks (ability in 3 tabs, body profile in 3), and a rail; CA/PA shown only as 1–5 stars and knowledge-gated ranges as text.
reason: The profile is opened from every surface, so a Peek drawer for quick looks plus a full editorial page cuts navigation churn; the Feature Profile treats own and knowledge-gated players with the same layout (ranges tighten as knowledge grows). Embed the Dossier attribute matrix (A) inside its Egenskaper section.

alternatives.name: Dossier
alternatives.concept: A two-column instrument: a sticky identity column (number, position, age, nation, status chips, contract, squad tier, knowledge meter for external) and a work column with four URL tabs: Översikt, Egenskaper & utveckling, Kontrakt & transfer, Historik. Attributes are a sequential-ramp matrix with deltas and a compare toggle.
alternatives.layout: Left 3/12 sticky identity column; right 9/12 tabbed workspace; compare toggle overlays a second player or squad average on the matrix.
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Status and role (availability, energy, morale). 2) Attribute matrix and ability band. 3) Contract and history.
alternatives.interactions: Tabs via ?tab=; compare picker (search) overlays deltas; hover/long-press any attribute for its development events (previous → new); one primary contextual CTA in the identity column.
alternatives.navigation: Other surfaces can deep-link (/career/squad/[id]?tab=kontrakt); prev/next player arrows within the current squad view.
alternatives.desktop: Identity column + 9-col matrix; no long scroll on Översikt.
alternatives.mobile: Identity collapses to a sticky compact bar; tabs become a segmented control; matrix becomes family accordions.
patterns: Attribute bars + numbers, fogged by scouting

alternatives.name: Athlete Spotlight
alternatives.concept: Broadcast-style hero: full-bleed portrait, giant name and shirt number in club colours, signature strengths as badges ("Kanonskott", "Läser spelet"), season stats as TV graphics (Mål, Skott %, Betyg), a career ribbon. Attributes live on a secondary tab.
alternatives.layout: Full-bleed hero (60 vh) → stat graphic band → strengths badges → career ribbon; tabs for Egenskaper, Kontrakt, Person.
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Identity and star quality. 2) Season numbers. 3) Detail on tabs.
alternatives.interactions: Scroll-driven stat count-ups (reduced-motion safe); tap a badge to see the attributes behind it; action dock with primary CTA.
alternatives.navigation: Entered from squad Locker Room and market cards; back returns to scroll position.
alternatives.desktop: Hero with portrait right, text left; stat band in 4 tiles.
alternatives.mobile: Portrait-first full screen, swipe up for stats; tabs as bottom sheet.
cons: Needs new data: portraits / likeness assets

alternatives.name: Feature Profile + Peek
alternatives.concept: Editorial profile with a kicker ("Högersexa · #23 · 24 år") and headline, a Profile column of strengths/weaknesses in words, attribute groups with inline bars, an ability/potential band, a person timeline (morale factors, promises, talks, injuries, transfers) and a season ledger. A Peek drawer variant opens from any player mention.
alternatives.layout: Full page: header band → two columns (8/12 story: profile words, attribute groups, development timeline; 4/12 rail: condition, contract, scout report). Peek: 480 px right drawer with header, condition, top attributes, primary CTA, "Öppna hela profilen".
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Who he is and his state in words. 2) Attribute groups and development. 3) Contract, report, history in the rail and timeline.
alternatives.interactions: Peek from anywhere without losing context; ranges for external players drawn as error bars with inline "Scouta"; section anchors in a sticky mini-nav.
alternatives.navigation: Peek → full page; full page sections are URL anchors; person timeline items link to inbox threads and match reports.
alternatives.desktop: Two-column journal layout; Peek drawer over any page.
alternatives.mobile: Peek becomes a half-height bottom sheet that expands to the full profile; single column with sticky section headers.
pros: Works equally for own, external and retired players
cons: Editorial wording must be generated from data (copy quality risk)
patterns: Attribute bars + numbers, fogged by scouting

current: Profil & egenskaper tab: a 4-stat season strip, PlayerDynamicsPanel and the full 56-attribute grid; rail with ability, scout report, medical and a note — very long for own players.
reason: A summary hero with key ratings answers the first question quickly and pushes grids to the Egenskaper section, ending the long scroll.

alternatives.name: Key-ratings summary
alternatives.concept: Ability/potential band, the 6 most role-relevant attributes, readiness gauges and the season strip on one screen.
alternatives.layout: Two rows: ratings + readiness; season strip + form.
alternatives.interactions: "Visa alla egenskaper" jumps to the matrix.
cons: Role relevance needs a defined attribute subset per position

alternatives.name: Storyline overview
alternatives.concept: Three generated storyline cards (Form, Utveckling, Personen) each with one number and one sentence, then the season strip.
alternatives.interactions: Tap a story to jump to its section.

alternatives.name: Decisions-first overview
alternatives.concept: Opens with what needs deciding about this player (renewal window, open concern, transfer request, rest advice) as numbered decision cards, then the summary.
cons: Empty for most players most of the time

current: Prestation & historik: season strip, last-12-matches table and season history table; no charts; same component reused in Klubbhistorik.
reason: A trend chart over the existing match log adds insight cheaply and links each match to its report.

alternatives.name: Trend chart + match log
alternatives.concept: Rating line over the last 12 matches with goal/save bars; below, the match log with each row linking to the match report.
alternatives.layout: Chart over table; season history below.
alternatives.interactions: Tap a chart point = highlight the row; row → ANL-01.
alternatives.mobile: Chart full width, log as cards.

alternatives.name: Season ledger
alternatives.concept: Editorial ledger of seasons with inline bars and career totals, current season expanded with its match log.
alternatives.layout: Ledger table with expandable current season.

current: Egenskaper tab: attribute grid with a rail of ability, body profile and scout report; a near-duplicate of the overview tab.
reason: Merging attributes and development into one workspace removes the duplicate tab and gives attributes their history.

alternatives.name: Attributes & development workspace
alternatives.concept: One section with the attribute matrix, deltas since last month and development events per attribute.
pros: One place for "how good, how improving"

alternatives.name: Role lens
alternatives.concept: Choose a role (attack/defence role proficiencies) and attributes reorder and highlight by relevance to it.
cons: Needs new data: exposed role→attribute weighting map

current: Utveckling tab: current level and potential as star text ("★★★☆☆"), individual focus label (read-only) and the last 5 development events.
reason: A progression visual with editable focus turns a read-only list into a development tool; flag the CA history need honestly.

alternatives.name: Development curve + focus
alternatives.concept: Non-numeric ability band over time against the potential ceiling band, event markers with attribute previous → new, and the individual focus as an editable segmented control.
alternatives.layout: Curve 8/12 + focus card 4/12; events list below.
alternatives.hierarchy: Gap to potential, then recent growth, then focus.
alternatives.interactions: Change focus in place; tap a marker for the event.
alternatives.mobile: Curve full width, focus as chips.
cons: Needs new data: periodic ability snapshots for the curve (only events exist today)

d: Ability vs potential band over time|8|chart

alternatives.name: Growth ledger
alternatives.concept: Development events as delta chips grouped by attribute family (e.g. "Avslut 12 → 13"), with stars as a graphic and a focus card.

current: Kontrakt tab: contract panel with renewal flow, transfer status card and market value split across 3 panels; rail with club history and training compensation; no budget context.
reason: One deal sheet with budget impact answers "can I afford to keep him?" in one place.

alternatives.name: Deal sheet
alternatives.concept: Single sheet: contract facts, market value (exact or range), renewal flow and a payroll/budget impact bar.
alternatives.layout: Facts row, budget bar, renewal panel.
alternatives.hierarchy: Days left and value, then budget, then action.
cons: Budget data must be joined in

alternatives.name: Contract timeline
alternatives.concept: A horizontal timeline from today to contract end with season boundaries, renewal window, promises and loan periods.

current: Klubbhistorik tab: club history entries by age, training compensation and PlayerPerformance repeated; rail body profile.
reason: A career ribbon is the clearest form for club history and removes the repeated performance block.

alternatives.name: Career ribbon
alternatives.concept: Horizontal ribbon of clubs by age with crest chips and training-compensation shares as segment labels.

alternatives.name: Merge into Historik
alternatives.concept: Club history becomes a section of a single Historik tab with season ledger.

current: Photo hero band (name, number, position, age, nation, club colours, status, tier, captain/7m) followed by a flat row of 3–4 equal-weight buttons.
reason: A sticky compact identity bar with one contextual primary CTA makes the next action obvious on every scroll position.

alternatives.name: Sticky identity bar + primary CTA
alternatives.concept: Header collapses to a sticky bar; one primary action chosen from state (own: "Förläng kontrakt" when expiring, "Svara på oro" on concern; external: "Scouta" when knowledge low, "Lägg bud" when high), others in an overflow menu.
alternatives.interactions: Overflow menu for Jämför, Kortlista, Transferlista.
alternatives.navigation: CTA routes to REC-04 / SQD-02n / REC-01.
alternatives.mobile: Bar + floating CTA above tab bar.
cons: CTA rules must be well defined

alternatives.name: Spotlight hero + action dock
alternatives.concept: Full-bleed portrait hero with name in giant type; actions in a dock at the hero bottom.

alternatives.name: Kicker header + numbered actions
alternatives.concept: Editorial kicker and headline with actions as a numbered list of what this player needs from you.
alternatives.layout: Header + decision list on the right.

current: Own-player Tillstånd panel: availability chip, state select, injury and rehab, return date, match-fitness band and two native <meter> bars.
reason: A shared condition gauge set gives the same visual language for energy and match fitness in squad, profile and matchday.

alternatives.name: Condition gauge set
alternatives.concept: Energy ring, match-fitness bar with band labels and the 80 % full-effect marker, availability chip and rehab progress bar.

alternatives.name: Readiness timeline
alternatives.concept: A 28-day chart of daily load with energy line and the return date marker.
cons: Heavier than needed for a status panel

current: Spelaren som person: morale meter with factor chips, intentions, concerns with options, transfer-request decision card, promises, bids, and transfer-list/release buttons with inline confirm; destructive release sits next to listing.
reason: A mood hub with causes and a separated danger zone makes morale actionable and protects irreversible actions.

alternatives.name: Mood hub with causes
alternatives.concept: Morale meter vs target with a factor waterfall (±points), open concerns/requests as decision cards, promises with status, and a separate "Riskzon" for release.
alternatives.layout: Meter + waterfall, decision cards, danger zone.
alternatives.hierarchy: Mood and why, then decisions, then risks.
alternatives.interactions: Resolve cards inline; release behind a modal confirm.

alternatives.name: Person timeline
alternatives.concept: Chronological feed of talks, promises, concerns, bids and morale changes, with the current open item pinned on top.
cons: Harder to see current morale drivers

current: Own players: dark gradient strip with a 160 px family radar and family tiles, then all 56 outcourt / 21 GK attributes with hard-coded tier-coloured bars; no deltas, no role weighting.
reason: A tokenised heat matrix with deltas and compare overlay serves power users and maps cleanly to every identity.

alternatives.name: Heat matrix
alternatives.concept: Families as columns (Teknik, Perception/beslut, Taktik, Försvar, Fysik, Mental; GK: 4 families), attributes as tiles with value and tokenised tier ramp, ▲/▼ deltas since last month, role-relevant tiles outlined.
alternatives.hierarchy: Family averages, then outliers, then deltas.
alternatives.interactions: Compare toggle overlays another player/squad average; tap tile for history.
patterns: Attribute bars + numbers, fogged by scouting

alternatives.name: Radar showcase
alternatives.concept: A large family radar that expands into petals; tapping a petal reveals that family's attribute bars.

alternatives.name: Report bars with words
alternatives.concept: Grouped inline bars with verbal grades (Elit ≥17, Stark ≥14, Bra ≥11 …) and a one-line summary per family.

current: Förmåga & Positionskarta: CA/PA as 1–5 stars, SVG mini-court with only the primary position lit, role proficiencies as text.
reason: A suitability court shows primary, secondary and role proficiency spatially using data that already exists.

alternatives.name: Suitability court
alternatives.concept: Mini court with all 7 spots shaded (primary solid, secondary partial), attack and defence role proficiencies as chips beside the court, and the ability band above.
alternatives.hierarchy: Ability band, then positions, then roles.
alternatives.interactions: Tap a spot for role chips at that spot.

alternatives.name: Ability band only
alternatives.concept: CA/PA drawn as a star band with the gap shaded, roles as a ranked list; no court.

current: External players: ability/potential as star-range text ("2–4 ★") with a knowledge tier badge; attributes reduced to strengths/weaknesses lists; no scout CTA in the panel.
reason: Range bars that visibly tighten make scouting meaningful and are honest about uncertainty.

alternatives.name: Tightening range bars
alternatives.concept: Ability and potential as range bars on the star scale, width from knowledge tier; strengths/weaknesses as chips; inline "Scouta nu".
patterns: Attribute bars + numbers, fogged by scouting

alternatives.name: Fogged card
alternatives.concept: Attribute grid rendered fogged in proportion to knowledge; known strengths revealed as clear tiles.
cons: Implies per-attribute knowledge that only exists as lists
patterns: Attribute bars + numbers, fogged by scouting

current: Scoutingrapport: value range, confidence %, recommendation, strengths/weaknesses, report history, "Scouta spelare" CTA; only the latest report shown.
reason: A report timeline shows how ranges narrowed over time, which is the payoff of scouting.

alternatives.name: Report timeline
alternatives.concept: Versions listed with scout and date; value and ability ranges drawn per version so narrowing is visible; latest expanded.
alternatives.interactions: Tap a version to compare with latest.
cons: Needs old report ranges kept (check history depth)

alternatives.name: Report as article
alternatives.concept: The scout's report as a short article with byline, recommendation as headline and a stamp.

current: ContractRenewal state machine: intention, blockers, talks, demand vs wage, role, demand factors, last response, waiting state, offer form, signing moment; feedback via a plain status line, no budget impact.
reason: A consequence preview (budget delta, demand gap) reduces guess-and-check, the main pain in contract flows.

alternatives.name: Offer with consequence preview
alternatives.concept: Demand vs offer slider with demand factors (±%) as a breakdown, payroll/budget delta bar and role promise, then send.
alternatives.layout: Demand breakdown left, offer form right, budget bar below.
alternatives.hierarchy: Gap to demand, then budget effect.
cons: Needs new data: acceptance likelihood if shown (omit otherwise)

alternatives.name: Shared talk stepper
alternatives.concept: Same stepper and round timeline as the transfer negotiation room (REC-04): Krav → Bud → Svar → Avtal.

current: PlayerTransferCard in the Transfer Centre tc-* skin: ownership chips, loan progress, competing interest, promise status and a negotiation CTA with deadline.
reason: One card system across profile and market removes the visual mismatch.

alternatives.name: Unified status card
alternatives.concept: Same card component as the profile, with deadline clock and promise state as chips.

alternatives.name: Hero status + drawer
alternatives.concept: Transfer state as a chip in the identity bar; detail in a drawer on tap.

current: MedicalPanel key-value rows: availability, injury type/severity/rehab phase/return/rehab %, last 5 injuries; duplicates Tillstånd and has no link to /career/medical.
reason: A rehab timeline uses existing phase and progress data and links to the medical page.

alternatives.name: Rehab timeline
alternatives.concept: Phase bar with progress, expected return marker relative to upcoming fixtures, and injury history markers.

alternatives.name: Body map
alternatives.concept: Body silhouette marking current and past injury locations.
cons: Needs new data: body location per injury type mapping

current: "Läser in spelarbetyg…" muted text while ratings load; "Spelaren hittades inte." with no way back.
